steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Enable eRFX project creation for the test company.
Allow vendors to be added during event creation.
Set the single-stage event type to RFQ.
Apply the first available RFQ pricing template.
Add the specified product and set its requested quantity.
Set the requested delivery location in the pricing sheet.
Add the specifically named vendor during event creation.
Commit the 30-minute schedule with the event starting now.
Confirm publishing reached a real project page.
Open the published RFQ stage's Participants list.
Find the named vendor's participant row.
Confirm Vendor A is listed and selected for the stage.
Confirm that Vendor A is the only participant.
